request: Fix common cross-repository CHAT result return: reflect PR296 ff-only main on Host with protected registry/stash checks; defer existing sink restart for safe result publication, then Publisher retries previously stalled requests

bounded_host_request.command:
set -e
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "2d9b34c358a25ed8e9c0cc1ac7ae34278f0e4d10"
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
test "$(git stash list | wc -l)" -eq 3
before="$(sha256sum operations/master-internal-repositories.json | cut -d' ' -f1)"
git fetch --no-tags origin main
git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD "6a85ac70ee4c27b88b3922d9e74cf6b81a833d51"
git merge-base --is-ancestor "6a85ac70ee4c27b88b3922d9e74cf6b81a833d51" FETCH_HEAD
test -z "$(git diff --name-only HEAD "6a85ac70ee4c27b88b3922d9e74cf6b81a833d51" -- operations/master-internal-repositories.json)"
git merge --ff-only "6a85ac70ee4c27b88b3922d9e74cf6b81a833d51" >/tmp/gace-result-sink-cross-repo-sha-reflect.log
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "6a85ac70ee4c27b88b3922d9e74cf6b81a833d51"
test "$(sha256sum operations/master-internal-repositories.json | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$before"
test "$(git stash list | wc -l)" -eq 3
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-servercore-result-sink.service
systemd-run --user --collect --on-active=35s --unit=gace-crossrepo-sink-source-refresh-20261016 /bin/sh -c 'systemctl --user restart gace-servercore-result-sink.service' >/dev/null
echo GACE_CROSSREPO_RESULT_SINK_SOURCE_REFLECT=PASS
git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD
echo GACE_SINK_RESTART_DEFERRED=YES
echo GACE_STASH_COUNT=3

chat_decision_checkpoint.source_evidence: PR #296 merged main 6a85ac70ee4c27b88b3922d9e74cf6b81a833d51, six CI passed. Last live Dispatcher 2d9b34 from Run 38846896784, three AICore Writers/Sinks all present mask3f but no Issue #10 comments. Writer.source_sha targets ai-core not Dispatcher, fixed Result Sink source. Only existing service restart.
